programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Florida Panthers host the Edmonton Oilers in NHL regular-season play at Amerant Bank Arena. The Florida Panthers hold a 3-2 advantage over the Edmonton Oilers across their last five NHL meetings, including a 4-0 shutout in Edmonton in March 2026.
